title: feat(dynamicWidgets): add default attributesToRender & transformItems
body:
**Summary**

Retrieves the default attributesToRender from the result, and gives a default to transformItems now

**Result**

* \[x] retrieve attributesToRender from the result
* \[x] add a default for transformItems (identity)
* \[x] update helper & client with new TS (https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-client-javascript/pull/1273, https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-helper-js/pull/823)
